key_points: Tesla secures $30B credit facilities to fund AI and robotaxi spending, improving liquidity.
Roadster reveal postponed to Oct 15 due to weather, a minor delay.
Analysts expect ~7% decline in Q3 deliveries, pressuring near-term sentiment.
FSD faces opposition in Sweden and regulatory hurdles in China, limiting rollout prospects.
Speculation about a Tesla-SpaceX merger and Cathie Wood's comments remain noise without concrete action.
